C-70.Name: Copy a table as a picture — from the table toolbar and the full-screen view, like diagrams
C-70.Summary: User request 2026-10-19: tables should leave Mark as images the way diagrams do (C-56). The table toolbar (C-65) gains «Copy as image»; the full-screen table view gains the C-56 export buttons (Copy as image, Save as PNG…, Save as SVG…).

Problem.Description: Only Pele diagrams and Vega-Lite charts export as pictures; a table can only be copied as Markdown/HTML. Serializing table HTML into an SVG foreignObject taints the canvas in WKWebView, so the C-56 rasterizer cannot take it as is.

Goals.R-1: utils/tableExport.js draws a rendered table as a standalone SVG from its live layout: panel background, table/row/cell backgrounds, cell borders, inline code/mark/kbd chips, and every word as a text element at its measured box in its computed font/size/weight/style/colour with textLength pinned to the measured width (a differently resolved font cannot overflow a cell); editor chrome (resize handles, toolbar, caption) and images are skipped; 16 px padding. No foreignObject.
Goals.R-2: The table toolbar shows «Copy as image» (the diagram pill's glyph and blockToolbar.copyImage label) between the width toggle and Open full screen; the click dispatches muya-diagram-export copyImage with the table figure; editor.vue handleDiagramExportAction gains the table branch (2× PNG on the clipboard through the C-56 transport, the same toasts).
Goals.R-3: The full-screen view of a table shows the C-56 export buttons; they export the live table (not the scaled clone), Save as PNG/SVG through the C-56 dialog path; the fallback file name is <doc>-table-N.
Goals.R-4: Unit tests for the SVG builder (geometry, colours, chips, chrome skipped, escaping, null on zero size) and the toolbar vnode; e2e: toolbar copy writes a 2× PNG, the viewer copy and Save as PNG/SVG work for a wide table; existing pins updated. grace lint 0.

Constraints.Item: Reuse the C-56 transport and rasterizer; no new capability.

NonGoals.Item: The editor context menu image items for tables (C-56 keeps them for diagrams).
Images and math inside cells are rendered as text/skipped in the picture.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: R-1..R-4 done; tests green; grace lint 0; live check: copy a wide table from the toolbar and from the full-screen view, paste into Preview/Telegram — the picture matches the table in the current theme.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: 2× PNG IHDR pins for the toolbar and viewer copies; a rendered PNG checked by eye.
